behaviors.description: Cave jars yield a specific single-use plank blueprint. F carries and places it on supported ground. Shift-left-click reserves one physically severed, horizontal tree within 4 metres. Sixty seconds of local work consumes tree and sheet and makes six individually F-carried planks. Rate is 1 within 10 metres, exponential to 0.01 at 20, then remains 0.01. Missing/moved ingredients pause progress. Session state only; no offline progress.

checks.expectation: Cave jars are reachable, ground recipes require felled wood, no input leaks to tools, completion produces six distinct movable planks.
checks.procedure: Run focused crafting regressions and inspect Blender review; playtest real cave discovery, felling, F placement, Shift-click, walking 10/15/20 metres away, returning, completion, individual pickup, pause and cleanup. Compilation is not native interaction evidence.
